name: Pro Schedules
description: Defaults applied to Pro schedules created without an explicit value, plus the global dispatch kill switch. The Research Assistant select is omitted because its options come from the assistant store.

settings.label: Default cadence
settings.description: Cadence for schedules created without one. Custom cadences registered through wp_get_schedules() are not listed here.

settings.label: Default time of day
settings.description: 24-hour HH:MM in the site time zone. An unparseable value falls back to 09:00.

settings.label: Max concurrent runs
settings.description: Soft cap on simultaneously running schedules, between 1 and 20.

settings.label: Retry count
settings.description: Retries attempted after a failed run, between 0 and 10.

settings.label: Error notification email
settings.description: Used when a schedule has no per-schedule override. Leave blank to fall back to the site admin address; an invalid address is discarded.

settings.label: Kill switch
settings.description: Disables dispatch for every Pro schedule without editing them individually.

settings.label: Enable Research & Add
settings.description: Enables the Research & Add workflow for creating schedules with AI.
